title: How to convert 12-hour text times to 24-hour
task: Turn "3:45 PM" strings from exports into real 24-hour times.
keywords: text time to real time google sheets

excel.note: Drop the TEXT wrapper to keep a real time value for math; format the cell as HH:MM instead.

explanation: TIMEVALUE parses a time written as text — including the AM/PM suffix — into the day-fraction spreadsheets use, and TEXT with an HH code renders it 24-hour style: "3:45 PM" → "15:45". For calculations (durations, sorting), skip the TEXT wrapper and just format the TIMEVALUE cell as HH:MM — keeping it numeric. If TIMEVALUE returns #VALUE!, the text has a nonbreaking space or stray characters; TRIM/SUBSTITUTE it clean first.
